exclusion_detail: The paper reports the chemical synthesis (Fmoc solid-phase peptide synthesis, native chemical ligation, oxidative folding) of the 59-residue disulfide-rich peptide TFF3, its homodimer and truncated peptide fragments; peptides/proteins are out of scope.

lead.label: TFF3 (and homodimer)
lead.why: Abstract: 'we report the chemical synthesis of TFF3 and its homodimer via native chemical ligation followed by oxidative folding'

notes: Read the title and abstract only; no small-molecule synthesis is the subject.
